$comment: The marketplace fee calculator: what a sale leaves the creator after Roblox's commission, and what to charge to clear a target. Separate from the DevEx calculator because it answers a different question about a different kind of Robux.

inputs.amountToKeepHint: What you want left after the commission.

results.tableCaption: How the Robux from this sale are divided

intro.p2: Price as a multiple of the price floor
intro.p3: Price floors differ by item category, so this asks for the multiple rather than assuming one universal floor. An item priced at six times its floor or above reaches the top tier.
